description: Single source of truth mapping every manual test case (TC) to an automated execution unit. The orchestrator (run-tradeflow-suite.mjs) reads this file, groups cases into execution units, and runs Maestro (iOS + Android) for mobile cases and Playwright for admin-web cases. Cases without a reliable automation asset are reported as pending/manual with a reason so QA knows the true coverage instead of overstating it.

statusLegend.automated: Reliable automation asset exists and maps directly to this case. Executed by default.
statusLegend.partial: Asset covers the UI-observable portion only. Backend state, clock fast-forward, payment simulation, or a second device is required for full verification. Executed by default; report flags the manual residue.
statusLegend.pending: No automation asset exists yet for the target screen. Reported as a coverage gap (not a failure). Not executed until an asset is added and re-pointed here.
statusLegend.manual: Cannot be reliably automated in CI (real push delivery, multi-device realtime, external payment-provider decline, or time-travel beyond app control). Stays manual; documented here for traceability.
